Scoped quality-gate runner for the module workspace. Git
Sourcesrc/shared\scripts\verify\scope-gates.mjs
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

SCOPES

Scope registry: module dirs, the per-module tsconfig and jest config, and policy flags. dirs — source roots eslint/stylelint scan. tsconfig — scoped compilation target. jest — the module's own Jest config (its tests live inside it). governance — also run the cross-cutting scan suite in shared/tests. a11y — include axe-scan + contrast-aaa in that governance run. lighthouse — the scope is eligible for Lighthouse performance checks.

SCOPE_ROOTS

Scope → module repository root. Every module is a git submodule whose own hooks ran its gates; root is where the stored gate result lives (<root>/reports/gate-result.json). 'app' is the shared module.

LINK_SCOPES

Submodule path (gitlink) → scope, derived from SCOPE_ROOTS.

PATH_SCOPE_RULES

Ordered most-specific first — first match wins.

GLOBAL_FILES

Files whose change ripples to every module (toolchain, lockfile, config).

GOVERNANCE_DIR

Governance scans that are NOT accessibility checks — style, JSDoc, and portability governance run for every gated scope including cms. The a11y pair (axe-scan, contrast-aaa) is appended only when the scope's a11y flag allows it.

scopeForPath

Maps one changed path to its scope (or 'shared' for infra/toolchain).

expand

Expands a scope set: 'shared'/'all' resolve to concrete scopes.

changedFiles

Lists files changed in a diff range (or the index for --staged). The 64 MiB maxBuffer absorbs mega-diffs — the default 1 MiB silently truncated a ~21k-file push and produced an empty list. A diff failure is fatal, not skippable: returning [] would push with zero gates.

runAsync

Async counterpart for parallel gate steps — spawns the check with piped stdio so concurrently-running children can't interleave their report blocks; the captured output is replayed under the step's banner on exit. extraEnv carries per-step overrides (e.g. a split JEST_MAX_WORKERS budget when two jest pools run side by side).

  • @param {string} label banner prefix
  • @param {string} cmd executable
  • @param {string[]} args argv
  • @param {object} [extraEnv] env overrides merged over process.env
  • @returns {Promise} resolves on exit 0, rejects otherwise

jestWorkerShare

Total jest-worker budget for a gate run — mirrors jest.preset's RAM-derived cap (2GiB/worker, cores−1) so two concurrent jest pools (module suite + governance) split the same ceiling instead of each claiming it whole.

  • @param {number} share fraction of the budget this pool gets
  • @returns {string} JEST_MAX_WORKERS value

runGovernance

Runs the cross-cutting governance suite (shared/tests/governance) under the shared module's Jest config. Scopes flagged a11y: false (cms) exclude the axe/contrast pair per the workspace contract.

resultFile

Stored gate-result path for a module — reports/ is gitignored, so the stamp is a local artifact: the superproject validates it locally before pushing, and CI (fresh checkout, no reports) simply falls back to running the gates.

gitlinkSha

The commit a parent's HEAD gitlink points at for a submodule path.

moduleHead

The module worktree's own HEAD — what its hooks stamped.

stamp

Stamps a passing gate run: <module>/reports/gate-result.json records the module HEAD and the checks that ran, so later parent-level pushes of the same commit validate instantly instead of re-running.

runScope

Runs the gate set for one scope and stamps the stored result. All checks are independent read-only runs, so they execute CONCURRENTLY — the lint trio (tsc/eslint/stylelint) plus the jest pair. When a scope runs both jest pools, each gets half the RAM-derived worker budget via JEST_MAX_WORKERS so the aggregate stays under the same ceiling a single full-size pool would use. A failed check rejects; Promise.allSettled lets the rest finish their buffered output before the error surfaces.

runLink

const runJest = exists(def.jest) const runGov = def.governance

// Two concurrent jest pools split the worker budget 50/50; a lone pool // keeps the full share. const jestShare = runJest && runGov ? 0.5 : 1

if (runJest) { checks.push('jest') tasks.push( runAsync(${scope} jest, 'node', [...JEST, '--config', def.jest], { JEST_MAX_WORKERS: jestWorkerShare(jestShare), }) ) }

if (runGov) { checks.push('governance') tasks.push(runGovernance(scope, def.a11y, { JEST_MAX_WORKERS: jestWorkerShare(jestShare) })) }

const results = await Promise.allSettled(tasks) const failed = results.find((r) => r.status === 'rejected')

if (failed) throw failed.reason

stamp(scope, checks) }

/** Validates a gitlink bump via the module's stored gate result. The module's own hooks stamped reports/gate-result.json when its commit was gated; if that stamp matches the commit the parent is about to record, nothing re-runs. Missing/stale stamps fall back to the scope's full gate set (then re-stamp) — the gate stays honest either way.
